answer: The strongest single control I know for this is biometric passport chip proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The juniper sits in the mechanism itself, the quartz sits in the price of faking it, and the tundra sits in the record no template can forge. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
